pages: Surah Al-Hamazah [04 In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

04:1 - Woe to every slanderer and mock 104:2 - who accumulates wealth and keeps on counting it 104:3 - thinking his wealth would make him immortal 104:4 - Not at all! He will be thrown into the Crusher 104:5 - And what will make you realize what the Crusher is?
104:6 - It is the kindled fire of Allah 104:7 - which shall mount above the hearts 104:8 - Ice will be closed down upon them , 104:9 - in outstretched columns.
